PluginData.Author: scotlandsyard
PluginData.Tooltip: Inventory sorting, block restocking and autocraft quotas, set up in an in-game menu.
PluginData.Description:
Inventory management and auto-restocking, set up in an in-game menu instead of block names or Custom Data.
- Shows the inventory of every ship and station you own. - Sorts items into the storage blocks you choose. - Keeps blocks between a minimum and a maximum of an item: lockers, reactors, generators, turrets, refineries. - Keeps grid-wide quotas by queuing the shortfall in assemblers. - Fills a crate with the materials to build a list of blocks. - Shows status pages on LCD screens.
Quick start: 1. Type /ssm in chat and pick your grid. 2. In Overview, turn Automation on (off on every new grid, nothing moves until then). 3. For autocraft: set an assembler to Main in Production, set quotas in Items & quotas, turn Autocraft on.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/tree/main/Projects/Sacrificial%20Stockpile%20Manager Report bugs: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/issues
